title: Fishwives of Paris
author: Caroline Fazeli & Emily Monaco
description: Flipping the table on French food mythology and serving the real stories behind your favorite cuisine, with culinary journalist Emily Monaco and wine expert Caroline Fazeli. Want to watch us in 4k? Head over to https://youtube.com/@fishwivesofparis

episodes_recents.titre: Is French Restaurant Service Finally Getting Better?
Is a Lyon Bouchon Just a Restaurant Tourist Trap?
Is Bordeaux Really That Expensive? Bordeaux Through the Decades with Jane Anson
Can You Make Substitutions at French Restaurants?
We Remember Le Marché des Enfants Rouges, Paris’s Oldest Covered Market

extraits.texte: I love how the fishwives tell the hidden life of france’s most iconic food while keeping it real. You’ll love it if you’re a culture vulture, history buff, francophile foodie… or just anyone who loves a good throughline that unveils what’s behind the mysterious je ne sais quoi we…
I love hearing these ladies get to the truth behind the French cuisine. They make me laugh & learn! I often get the impression that we’re sitting around a table chatting.

extraits.titre: Finally a smart podcast on French food
extraits.texte: Such an interesting and well researched podcast about French food that isn’t stuffy! Loved it!
